version.changelog:
p-video-animate 1.0.14

- Updated skill metadata version to 1.0.14 in SKILL.md.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or usage instructions.

llm.summary: The skill is mostly purpose-aligned for Pruna video animation, but it tells agents to install unpinned helper skills and upload user media to an external API, so users should review it before use.

dimensions.detail: Uploading a source video and reference image to api.pruna.ai is expected for this feature, but users should treat this as third-party processing of potentially personal media.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact instructs agents to run multiple npx skills add commands, including a full-suite install and follow-on installs, without immutable version pins or integrity checks.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to confirm required inputs before posting and gives bounded Pruna endpoints, but it also includes an optional disable_safety_checker parameter without guardrails.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installing additional skills changes the agent environment beyond this single skill, and the unpinned helper skill set can alter future agent behavior if upstream content changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, animating a reference image using motion from a source video, matches the documented Pruna API workflow and required media inputs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with Pruna receiving the videos and images you provide, and prefer pinned or pre-reviewed helper skills instead of letting the agent install floating skill references automatically. Avoid confidential, regulated, or biometric media unless your organization approves that external processing.
llm.findings:
[RP1] unexpected: The unpinned npx skill installs are present in the artifact and are not necessary to be floating references; this supports Review because they mutate the agent's skill environment without fixed versions.
[E1] expected: The external uploads and prediction calls are real, but they are disclosed and central to the Pruna video-animation workflow rather than hidden exfiltration.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The supplied static scan reported no results; this lowers concern for embedded malicious code, persistence hooks, or instruction hijacking in the inspected Markdown artifact.
